In Fig. 6.1, $\text{SOCl}_{2}$ is given as the reagent that reacts with $\text{HOOCCOOH}$ to produce $\mathbf{G}$.

parts.label: (b)

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
$\text{HOOCCOOH}$ ionises as shown.

$$\text{HOOCCOOH} \rightleftharpoons \text{HOOCCOO}^{-} + \text{H}^{+}$$

$\text{HOOCCOOH}$ is a much stronger acid than methanoic acid, $\text{HCOOH}$.

Suggest an explanation for this difference in acidity.
